Intro: Marşalla xattar! I hope you seed a great fortune in these recipes. Do you love the aroma? Verehn has yet to taste the fields of Moġara, my friend…
…I wish the Kingdom believed in us, you know? We could've been mixing bowls together, but instead they sent us to the snow…God; why the snow?
I've heard a local rumor that a royal duchess remains in this city. Her accent is strong, so if you see her among us… do not hesitate to call them in.
In other news, I want to try a new recipe from Moġara, a [DISH] to be specific. I trust you are capable of making it well, young cook.
Success: A delightful aroma. It may not be the finest, but it is distinctly Mogaran. Thank you, young cook.
Fail: My recipes do not matter when the royals still live. Promise me we'll get justice, young cook.
Reject: A royalist, that's what you are! You are just a cruel bootlicker for the royals, you scum!
